verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a CLI coding assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. General config options and local-model support are adjacent features and do not count as a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
